module: "Gearbox" logic for electric vehicles: modes P R N D that set the rotation direction (motorDirection) of the electric motors, regenerative braking (regeneration on brake, one-pedal driving with force levels), friction brake compensation at low speed and smooth stop. Loaded by vehicleController when the "gearbox" device is of type electricMotor (or shiftLogicName). It computes M.regen (0..1 coefficient applied to the motors) and adjusts M.brake for the friction brakes. Publishes electrics.values.regenFromBrake, regenFromOnePedal, regenThrottle, maxRegenStrength and reads regenStrength.
notes: jbeam keys read in init: motorNames (name or list; default {"mainMotor"}), regenSmoothingRate (20), regenSmoothingAccel (5), onePedalSmoothStopBrakeReleaseAmount (0.85), onePedalRegenCoef (0.5), onePedalFrictionBrakeCoef (1), regenStrengthLevels (3), defaultRegenStrength (= regenStrengthLevels), regenThrottleNeutralPoint (0.15), automaticModes ("PRND"), defaultAutomaticMode ("P").
Modes P and N do not allow regeneration (regenHandling.unavailableGears); regen forced to 0.

One-pedal driving: the force level comes from electrics.values.regenStrength (0..regenStrengthLevels); the throttle zone below regenThrottleNeutralPoint (increased with speed up to 2.5 m/s) generates regeneration, above it is positive throttle (M.throttle is remapped).
M.regen is reduced by active ESC, by a strong lateral offset (|sensors.gx2| > 5 -> x0.8) and by the emergency brake (brake >= 1 -> x0.5).
At maximum force level, the friction brakes compensate for the loss of regeneration at low speed then lock at standstill (smoothStopTimeToLatch 0.25 s).
In P, the brake is at least arcadeAutoBrakeAmount; ignition < 2 forces P mode.
With no motor found: error log "No motors have been specified". M.checkEngine is set to 0 (number) whereas the other modules use a boolean.
Registers a quick menu (radial) entry to adjust regeneration (off / levels / full).

Common shiftLogic contract: gearboxHandling, timer, timerConstants, inputValues, shiftPreventionData, shiftBehavior, smoothedValues injected by vehicleController. M.running written without declaration.

regen.desc: Current regeneration coefficient (0..1) applied to the motors.

brake.desc: Final friction brake after deducting regeneration.

minGearIndex.desc: Absolute value of the smallest index.

smoothedAvgAVInput.desc: Average angular velocity of the devices of category "engine" (rad/s).

maxRPM.desc: Highest max speed of the motors.

checkEngine.desc: Declared boolean, but set to 0 (number) by updateExposedData.

updateGearboxGFX.desc: nop then inGear of the active mode.

init.desc: Gets the motors, builds the brake/regeneration curves, the smoothers, the modes, registers the quick menu and applies the default mode. Called by vehicleController (init and reset).

gearboxBehaviorChanged.desc: Selects the arcade or realistic logic.

getGearPosition.desc: Normalized lever position and mode index.

shiftUp.desc: Realistic: next mode in the list (P->R->N->D) and updates the motor direction.

shiftToGearIndex.desc: Realistic: selects the lever's mode; nonexistent -> message and N.

index.desc: Lever position (-1 R, 0 N, 1 P, 2 D).

sendTorqueData.desc: Asks each motor to send its torque curves to the UI.

setIgnition.desc: Turns the ignition of all motors on or off; called by vehicleController.setEngineIgnition when there is no main engine device.
